### The Spirit of the Antichrist
Author: Michael A. Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-september-12-2026.html
Passage: 1 John 2:22
Points:
- While many focus on the coming Antichrist, the spirit of antichrist already operates today through false teaching.
- Denying that Jesus is the Christ includes teaching that He is merely one among multiple paths to God.
- Deceptive teachings infiltrate churches and culture to prepare society for greater spiritual deception.
- Believers must stay vigilant and deeply rooted in God's Word to distinguish divine truth from error.
- Regardless of how many people are deceived, the adversary and his kingdom are doomed to ultimate defeat.
